reason: Λ is an inverted V; 'leaflets Λ-shaped in cross-section' (Elaeis, reduplicate leaflets) and the Bersama disc have a single angle along their length, which is PATO V-shaped.

label: half-cordate
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being shaped like one half of a heart, with a single rounded basal lobe on one side of the point of attachment.
reason: A standard glossary shape of asymmetric stipules, petals and crests. It is not a kind of PATO_0000948 heart shaped, because only one side has the basal lobe; this sibling under 2-D shape follows the FLOPO ovate and obcordate classes.
The fruit is both compressed (PATO_0002254 flattened) and obpyriform (an inverted pear shape, for which there is no term yet); these are two attributes at once, not a continuum.
The distal part of the inflorescence bears male flowers: male (PATO_0000384) with the position of the bearer (distal part of the inflorescence) in the bearer slot.

A margin between serrate (PATO_0001206) and crenate (PATO_0001889 scalloped) with gland-tipped teeth; this is a compound of two values, with glandular (PATO_0002117) as a further value, not a new term.
A colour compound: buff tinged with grey (grey PATO_0000950). PATO has no 'buff'; light yellow brown (PATO_0002413) is the nearest, so the second value is a doubtful match.

A keel on a leaf, sepal or leaf sheath is a longitudinal ridge, the same as the existing rule for carinate/keeled; 'without keel' is its negation. Do not map it to PO_0025327 keel, which is the pair of lower petals of a papilionaceous corolla.
FLOPO lyrate is already defined as pinnately lobed with a large terminal lobe and smaller lateral lobes, so 'lyrato-pinnately lobed' says the same thing.
Perfumed flowers have a pleasant, sweet odour, and FLOPO sweet-scented already has fragrant as a related synonym. PATO_0001331 odorous is the fallback if the pleasant sense is doubted.
Bark or a leaf marked with small, shallow, scattered depressions is pitted, which matches the previous rule for 'pitted'.
A sausage-like fruit or inflorescence is elongate and cylindrical with rounded ends; PATO cylindrical carries the shape.
Semicoriaceous means somewhat leathery, which is the definition of FLOPO subcoriaceous.
A likeness to a stipel, used only for the basal glands of one genus (Dalechampia); the property it compares is unstated, and a term is not justified.
'Ovary subcorneal' is not a botanical term; it is probably a transcription error for 'subconical' (or 'subcorneous'), which cannot be decided without the source.
sub- marks an approximate value, as in 'suborbicular': spatulate (PATO_0001937) with value_qualifier approximately.
An apex between truncate (PATO_0000936 truncated) and rounded (PATO_0001935 obtuse, synonym roundish); a compound of two values.
FLOPO foetid is an unpleasant, offensive odour and has 'unpleasant smell' as an exact synonym.

States that hooked trichomes are absent: the complement of has_part some (trichome and has_characteristic some falciform, which has hooked/uncinate as synonyms). It must not become 'trichome absent', because other hairs may be present.
The mouth of the capsule or spur is wide: increased width (PATO_0000600) with the mouth as the part of the bearer. PO_0030017 spore capsule mouth fits only the moss capsule.
Enrolled margins and stipules are rolled. The direction (involute PATO_0001962 or revolute PATO_0001963) is not always stated, so map to their parent, curled.
'Layers of palisade-like cells' in the leaf and mesophyll name the palisade tissue itself, not a quality. The domatia use is unclear and should get no rule.
A coarse, sacking-like palm leaf sheath is a network of tough fibres, which is FLOPO fibrous (texture).
Same reading as the previous rules for 'obscure' and 'indistinct': not clearly visible.
Half-spreading means directed between erect and patent, which is PATO semi erect (partially upright).
Stelliform means star-shaped; PATO star shaped has stellate as a synonym.
sub- marks an approximate value: somewhat pungent, i.e. ending in a rather sharp, stiff point; use sharp (PATO_0001419) with value_qualifier approximately.
A transcription of 'triangular-ovate': a continuum between triangular (PATO_0001875) and ovate (FLOPO:0991024); 'broadly' is a degree qualifier.
sub- marks an approximate value: sericeous (PATO_0104358) with value_qualifier approximately; the French 'subsoyeuse' is the same.
Papery but thick: papyraceous (PATO_0104010, synonym chartaceous) together with increased thickness (PATO_0000591), two values of one leaf.
A compound of two values, like 'linear-lanceolate': a continuum between lanceolate (PATO_0001877) and ovate (FLOPO:0991024).
